# finalize.finalize_statistics { #healpyxel.finalize.finalize_statistics }

```python
finalize.finalize_statistics(state, percentiles=None, min_count=1)
```

Convert accumulator state to final statistics DataFrame.

Iterates over all HEALPix cells in the state and computes summary
statistics from the accumulated streaming data. Cells with fewer
observations than ``min_count`` output NaN for all statistics.

Percentiles are computed from TDigest data when available. If no
TDigest data is present in the state, percentile columns are omitted
(set to NaN).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                         | Description                                                                                                           | Default    |
|-------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| state       | dict\[int, CellAccumulator\] | Accumulator state from :func:`healpyxel.accumulator.load_state` or :func:`healpyxel.accumulator.accumulate_batch`.    | _required_ |
| percentiles | list\[float\] or None        | List of percentiles to compute (e.g., ``[25, 50, 75]``). Default is empty list.                                       | `None`     |
| min_count   | int                          | Minimum observations required per cell. Cells below this threshold get NaN for all statistics (not just percentiles). | `1`        |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                                                                                                                            |
|--------|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pd.DataFrame | DataFrame indexed by ``healpix_id`` with columns: ``{col}_n``, ``{col}_mean``, ``{col}_std``, ``{col}_min``, ``{col}_max``, and ``{col}_p{N}`` (if TDigest available). |
